notes: Worked example coded by LLM pre-fill (Claude), NOT human-verified. Unit of analysis spans two repos: All-Hands-AI/OpenHands v1.16.0 (64c126965, Agent Canvas frontend) which pins openhands-agent-server 1.44.0, so agent behaviour is coded from OpenHands/software-agent-sdk v1.44.0 (322dec7d).
